Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.

p = 'sklearn/model_selection/_search.py'

# 1. add time import

new_imp = "from itertools import product\nimport operator\nimport time\nimport warnings\n"
assert s.count(old_imp) == 1

# 2. measure refit time
old_refit = """        if self.refit:
            self.best_estimator_ = clone(base_estimator).set_params(

            if y is not None:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, y, **fit_params)
            else:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, **fit_params)
"""
new_refit = """        if self.refit:
            self.best_estimator_ = clone(base_estimator).set_params(
                **self.best_params_)
            refit_start_time = time.time()
            if y is not None:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, y, **fit_params)
            else:
                self.best_estimator_.fit(X, **fit_params)
            refit_end_time = time.time()
            self.refit_time_ = refit_end_time - refit_start_time
"""
assert s.count(old_refit) == 1
s = s.replace(old_refit, new_refit)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("patched core")

import time
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=2),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3]}, cv=3)

assert isinstance(rs.refit_time_, float) or hasattr(rs.refit_time_, "__float__")
assert rs.refit_time_ >= 0

rscv = sklearn.model_selection.RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.svm.SVC(), param_grid={'C': [1, 10]}, n_iter=2, cv=3)
rscv.fit(X, y)
print("random refit_time_:", rscv.refit_time_)

# no refit -> attribute absent
rs2 = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.svm.SVC(), param_grid={'C': [1]}, cv=3, refit=False)
rs2.fit(X, y)
print("refit=False has refit_time_:", hasattr(rs2, "refit_time_"))

# refit_time_ should be at least in the ballpark of a full fit

sklearn.svm.SVC(C=1).fit(X, y)
print("direct fit time:", time.time() - t0)
print("OK")

Please solve this issue: Retrieving time to refit the estimator in BaseSearchCV
Basically, I'm trying to figure out how much time it takes to refit the best model on the full data after doing grid/random search. What I can so far do is retrieve the time it takes to fit and score each model:
```
import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print(rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])
```
In case I run this on a single core, I could time the whole search procedure and subtract the time it took to fit the single folds during hyperparameter optimization. Nevertheless, this isn't possible any more when setting `n_jobs != 1`.

Thus, it would be great to have an attribute `refit_time_` which is simply the time it took to refit the best model.

Usecase: for [OpenML.org](https://openml.org) we want to support uploading the results of hyperparameter optimization, including the time it takes to do the hyperparameter optimization.
